## 7 · Undo

<div class="type">Make dashboard.html rainbow-colored, with Comic Sans everywhere.</div>

Look at it. Enjoy it. Then:

::: {.two-col}
::: {}
<div class="type"><span class="cmd">/rewind</span></div>
:::

::: {}
![](../images/screens/{{< meta rainbow-shot >}}){.shot height="210" fig-alt="The dashboard after the rainbow request"}
:::
:::

Pick the message before the rainbow → **restore the code**. Reload. (Or <kbd>Esc</kbd> <kbd>Esc</kbd> on an empty prompt.)

::: {.card .red style="margin-top:16px"}
**Rewind restores what Claude edited. It can't undo shell commands** like deleting (`rm`) or moving (`mv`) files.
For real work: copies, or git.
:::

## 8 · Share

<div class="type">Publish dashboard.html as an artifact.</div>

- A private page on claude.ai, with a link
- **Share** in the page header → a public link anyone can open
- Needs Pro or higher; on Team/Enterprise plans public links may be off
- `/artifacts` lists everything you've published. Console account? Share a screenshot
